description: Add a dedicated test stage to a multi-stage build (separate from the runtime stage), so test dependencies never end up in the production image
prompts: The Dockerfile installs pytest directly alongside the app's real runtime dependencies and there is no way to run the test suite as part of the build without shipping pytest in the final image. Restructure it into three named stages: a `base` stage (python:3.12-slim, installs ONLY requirements.txt, copies app code), a `test` stage that starts `FROM base`, additionally installs pytest, copies the tests/ directory, and RUNs `pytest tests/` (so `docker build --target test` fails the build if tests fail), and a final (unnamed, last) stage that starts `FROM base` again and is the actual runtime image - it must NOT install pytest and must NOT copy tests/. The final stage keeps the original EXPOSE 8000 and CMD.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt pytest
COPY app ./app
COPY tests ./tests
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

test_setup_files.check_test_stage.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

raw = Path("Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]

from_lines = [(i, l) for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.upper().startswith("FROM ")]
assert len(from_lines) >= 3, f"expected at least 3 FROM stages (base/test/final), found {len(from_lines)}"

base_idx = next((i for i, l in from_lines if re.search(r"AS\s+base\b", l, re.IGNORECASE)), None)
assert base_idx is not None, "no stage named 'base' found"

test_idx = next((i for i, l in from_lines if re.search(r"AS\s+test\b", l, re.IGNORECASE)), None)
assert test_idx is not None, "no stage named 'test' found"
test_from_line = lines[test_idx]
assert re.search(r"FROM\s+base\b", test_from_line, re.IGNORECASE), (
    f"the test stage must be 'FROM base', got: {test_from_line}")

final_idx = from_lines[-1][0]
assert final_idx != test_idx, "the final (runtime) stage must not be the test stage itself"
final_from_line = lines[final_idx]
assert re.search(r"FROM\s+base\b", final_from_line, re.IGNORECASE), (
    f"the final runtime stage must be 'FROM base', got: {final_from_line}")

test_stage_lines = lines[test_idx:final_idx]
assert any("pytest" in l for l in test_stage_lines), "test stage never installs pytest"
assert any(re.search(r"RUN\s+pytest\s+tests", l, re.IGNORECASE) for l in test_stage_lines), (
    "test stage never actually runs pytest tests/")

final_stage_lines = lines[final_idx:]
assert not any("pytest" in l for l in final_stage_lines), (
    "the runtime (final) stage must not install or reference pytest")
assert not any("tests" in l and l.upper().startswith("COPY") for l in final_stage_lines), (
    "the runtime (final) stage must not COPY the tests/ directory")

assert any(l.upper().startswith("EXPOSE") and "8000" in l for l in final_stage_lines), (
    "EXPOSE 8000 missing from the final stage")
cmd_all = " ".join(l for l in final_stage_lines if l.upper().startswith(("CMD ", "ENTRYPOINT ")))
for needle in ("uvicorn", "app.main:app", "8000"):
    assert needle in cmd_all, f"final stage CMD changed - missing {needle!r}"

print("PASS multi-stage test-stage checks")

COPY tests ./tests
